name: Misaki
source:
Wife of the main character [Kazuya]. Serious and quiet, she has been withdrawn since childhood, has few friends, and often asks her mother for advice. 

As their relationship became routine, they became like a family of friends to whom they could talk about anything.

[from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt283/apt283.html#link_character]official site[/url]]
